chapterInfo.content:
32
Yeremia tɔ afuo bi
1Asɛm a ɛfiri AWURADE nkyɛn baa Yeremia nkyɛn Yudahene Sedekia afe a ɛtɔ so du a ɛne Nebukadnessar afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe no soɔ nie. 2#2 Ah 25.1-2 Ɛno mu, na Babel hene dɔm aka Yerusalem ahyɛ mu, na Odiyifoɔ Yeremia da dua mu, Yuda ahemfie awɛmfoɔ abannwa mu. 3#Yer 21.7; 27.6 Na Yudahene Sedekia ato no dua mu wɔ hɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na wohyɛ nkɔm sɛ: Sei na AWURADE seɛ: Hwɛ, mede kuro yi merehyɛ Babel hene nsa, na wafa, 4na Yudahene Sedekia rennya kwan mfiri Kaldeafoɔ nsa, na hyɛ na wɔde no bɛhyɛ Babel hene nsamu, na ɔne no de ano ne ano akasa, na ɔde n’ani ahunu n’ani, 5#Yer 52.11 na ɔde Sedekia bɛkɔ Babel, na ɛhɔ na ɔbɛtena akɔsi sɛ mɛba abɛhwɛ no, AWURADE asɛm nie. Sɛ mo ne Kaldeafoɔ ko a, ɛrensi mo yie.
6Na Yeremia kaa sɛ: AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 7#Lew 25.25; Rut 4.3-4 Hwɛ, w’agya nua Salum ba Hanamel bɛba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Tɔ m’afuo a ɛwɔ Anatot no, na wo na ɛgyeɛ fata wo sɛ wobɛtɔ. 8Ɛnna m’agya nua ba Hanamel baa me nkyɛn awɛmfoɔ abannwa no mu, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no kaeɛ no, bɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Tɔ m’afuo a ɛwɔ Anatot, Benyamin asase soɔ no, na wo na adeɛ no die ne ne gyeɛ wɔ woɔ. Tɔ fa! Ɛnna mehunuu sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE asɛm.
9Na metɔɔ afuo no m’agya nua ba Hanamel a ɔwɔ Anatot no nkyɛn, na mekarii dwetɛ nnwetɛbena dunson memaa no. 10Na metwerɛ hyɛɛ nwoma mu, na mesɔɔ ano, na mefrɛɛ adansefoɔ, na mede nsania karii dwetɛ no. 11Na mede ɔtɔ nwoma a wɔasɔ ano no, deɛ wɔadi ano na wɔahyehyɛ no, ne deɛ ano da hɔ no, 12na mede ɔtɔ nwoma no maa Maaseia ba Neria ba Baruk, m’agya nua Hanamel ne adansefoɔ a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ɔtɔ nwoma no aseɛ no ne Yudafoɔ a wɔtete awɛmfoɔ abannwa mu hɔ no nyinaa anim. 13Na wɔn anim mehyɛɛ Baruk sɛ: 14Sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Fa nwoma yi, ɔtɔ nwoma a wɔasɔ ano yi ne nwoma a ano da hɔ yi, na fa hyɛ kukuo bi mu na akyɛre nna bebree. 15Na sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, seɛ nie: Wɔbɛtɔ adan ne mfuo ne nturo asase yi so bio.
Yeremia mpaebɔ ne n’adesrɛ
16Na mede ɔtɔ nwoma no maa Neria ba Baruk no, mebɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: 17#Yer 27.5; Luka 1.37 Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, hwɛ, wo na wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo basa a atene ayɛ ɔsoro ne asase; biribiara nyɛ wo nwanwa; 18#Eks 20.5-6 woyɛ nnipa mpem mpem adɔeɛ, na wotua agyanom amumuyɛ so ka gu wɔn mma a wɔdi wɔn akyire kokom, wo Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ ne otumfoɔ a asafo AWURADE ne ne din no. 19#Rom 2.6 Wo a woso, agyinatuo mu na w’adeyɛ dɔɔso. Wo a w’ani bue hwɛ nnipa mma akwan nyinaa, sɛ wobɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’akwan ne ne nneyɛɛ aba teɛ no. 20Wo a woyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ Misraim asase so de bɛsii nnɛ da yi, ne Israel ne nnipa nyinaa mu, na wode gyee din, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. 21Na wode nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a atene ne ahudeɛ kɛseɛ yii wo man Israel firii Misraim asase so, 22na womaa wɔn asase yi a wokaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom sɛ wode bɛma wɔn, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ. 23Na wɔba bɛdii soɔ no, wɔantie wo, na wɔanni wo mmara so; deɛ wohyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no nyinaa, wɔanyɛ, enti na woama bɔne yi nyinaa abɛto wɔn yi. 24Hwɛ, epie no reduru kuro no ho sɛ wɔrebɛgyeɛ, na wɔde kuro no bɛhyɛ Kaldeafoɔ a wɔne no reko no nsa, afena ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ ano, na nsɛm a wokaeɛ no aba mu, na hwɛ, wohunu. 25Na wo, AWURADE Nyankopɔn ara, woka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Fa dwetɛ tɔ afuo no, na hyɛ ho adansefoɔ. Nso kuro no na wɔde rehyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa yi.
Nyankopɔn mmuaeɛ
26Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa Yeremia nkyɛn sɛ: 27#Num 16.22; Yer 32.17 Hwɛ, me AWURADE ne ɔhonam nyinaa Nyankopɔn; biribi bɛyɛ me den anaa? 28#Yer 32.3 Enti sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede kuro yi merehyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa ne Babelhene Nebukadnessar nsa sɛ ɔmfa, 29#Yer 19.13 na Kaldeafoɔ a wɔne kuro yi reko no bɛba abɛto kuro yi mu gya, na wɔahye ɛno ne adan a wɔahye atifi aduhwam ama Baal na wɔahwie ahwiesa ama anyame foforɔ, sɛ wɔde rehuru me boɔ no. 30Na Israelfoɔ ne Yudafoɔ de m’anim bɔne yɛ ara nko firi wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu. Na ohuro nko ara na Israelfoɔ de wɔn nsa ano adwuma huru me boɔ, AWURADE asɛm nie. 31Na abufuo ne abufuhyeɛ nko na kuro yi ahyɛ me, firi da a wɔkyekyereeɛ de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, sɛ menyi no mfiri m’anim, 32Israelfoɔ ne Yudafoɔ bɔne a wɔyɛɛ no, sɛ wɔde rehuru me boɔ no nyinaa nti, wɔn ne wɔn ahemfo, wɔn mmapɔmma, wɔn asɔfoɔ ne wɔn adiyifoɔ ne Yuda mmarima ne Yerusalemfoɔ. 33Na wɔdanedanee wɔn atikɔ kyerɛɛ me, na ɛnyɛ wɔn anim; na wɔtuaa nhema kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn, na wɔn deɛ, wɔantie sɛ wɔbɛgye nkyerɛkyerɛ. 34#Yer 7.30; 2 Ah 21.4-5 Na wɔsisii wɔn akyiwadeɛ, efie a wɔde me din atoɔ no mu de guu ho fi. 35#Yer 7.31; 19.5 Na wɔsisii Baal sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Hinom ba bonhwa mu no, sɛ wɔrema wɔn mmabanin ne wɔn mmammaa afa ogya mu ama Molek, nso menhyɛɛ wɔn na ɛmmaa m’akoma mu da sɛ wɔnyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mma Yuda nyɛ bɔne.
36Na afei saa nti, sei na AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ka no kuro yi a mose afena ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ nti, ɔde ahyɛ Babel hene nsa no ho. 37Hwɛ, me ara mɛboa wɔn ano afiri nsase a m’abufuo ne m’abufuhyeɛ ne anibereɛ kɛseɛ mu mesunsumm wɔn kɔɔ hɔ no nyinaa so, na mede wɔn asane aba ha bio, na mama wɔatena ase dwoodwoo, 38#Yer 24.7; 30.22; 31.1, 33 na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn. 39#Hes 36.27 Na mɛma wɔn akoma korɔ ne ɔkwan korɔ, na wɔasuro me daa nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyire no yie. 40Na me ne wɔn bɛpam daa apam, na merensane mfiri wɔn akyiri sɛ merenyɛ wɔn yie bio, na mede me suro bɛhyɛ wɔn akoma mu, na wɔamfiri me nkyɛn. 41Na me ho bɛsane me wɔn ho sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn yie, na mede wɔn madua asase yi so nokorɛ mu, m’akoma nyinaa mu ne me kra nyinaa mu.
42Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Sɛdeɛ me bɔne kɛseɛ yi nyinaa aba ɔman yi soɔ no, saa ara na mɛma yie a maka no wɔn ho no nyinaa bɛba wɔn soɔ. 43Na wɔbɛtɔ mfuo, asase yi a moka sɛ ayɛ amamfo a onipa ne aboa nni so bio a wɔde ahyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa no so; 44#Yer 29.14; 30.3 wɔde sika bɛtotɔ mfuo, na wɔatwerɛ agu nwoma mu asosɔ ano ahyehyɛ ho adansefoɔ, Benyamin asase so ne Yerusalem ho, ne Yuda nkuro mu ne mmepɔ so nkuro mu, ne mmepɔ ase nkuro mu ne Negeb nkuro mu, na mede wɔn nnommum bɛsane aba, AWURADE asɛm nie.

pageProps.chapterText:
Asɛm a ɛfiri AWURADE nkyɛn baa Yeremia nkyɛn Yudahene Sedekia afe a ɛtɔ so du a ɛne Nebukadnessar afe a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe no soɔ nie. Ɛno mu, na Babel hene dɔm aka Yerusalem ahyɛ mu, na Odiyifoɔ Yeremia da dua mu, Yuda ahemfie awɛmfoɔ abannwa mu. Na Yudahene Sedekia ato no dua mu wɔ hɔ sɛ: Adɛn nti na wohyɛ nkɔm sɛ: Sei na AWURADE seɛ: Hwɛ, mede kuro yi merehyɛ Babel hene nsa, na wafa, na Yudahene Sedekia rennya kwan mfiri Kaldeafoɔ nsa, na hyɛ na wɔde no bɛhyɛ Babel hene nsamu, na ɔne no de ano ne ano akasa, na ɔde n’ani ahunu n’ani, na ɔde Sedekia bɛkɔ Babel, na ɛhɔ na ɔbɛtena akɔsi sɛ mɛba abɛhwɛ no, AWURADE asɛm nie. Sɛ mo ne Kaldeafoɔ ko a, ɛrensi mo yie.
Na Yeremia kaa sɛ: AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Hwɛ, w’agya nua Salum ba Hanamel bɛba wo nkyɛn sɛ: Tɔ m’afuo a ɛwɔ Anatot no, na wo na ɛgyeɛ fata wo sɛ wobɛtɔ. Ɛnna m’agya nua ba Hanamel baa me nkyɛn awɛmfoɔ abannwa no mu, sɛdeɛ AWURADE asɛm no kaeɛ no, bɛka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Tɔ m’afuo a ɛwɔ Anatot, Benyamin asase soɔ no, na wo na adeɛ no die ne ne gyeɛ wɔ woɔ. Tɔ fa! Ɛnna mehunuu sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE asɛm.
Na metɔɔ afuo no m’agya nua ba Hanamel a ɔwɔ Anatot no nkyɛn, na mekarii dwetɛ nnwetɛbena dunson memaa no. Na metwerɛ hyɛɛ nwoma mu, na mesɔɔ ano, na mefrɛɛ adansefoɔ, na mede nsania karii dwetɛ no. Na mede ɔtɔ nwoma a wɔasɔ ano no, deɛ wɔadi ano na wɔahyehyɛ no, ne deɛ ano da hɔ no, na mede ɔtɔ nwoma no maa Maaseia ba Neria ba Baruk, m’agya nua Hanamel ne adansefoɔ a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ɔtɔ nwoma no aseɛ no ne Yudafoɔ a wɔtete awɛmfoɔ abannwa mu hɔ no nyinaa anim. Na wɔn anim mehyɛɛ Baruk sɛ: Sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Fa nwoma yi, ɔtɔ nwoma a wɔasɔ ano yi ne nwoma a ano da hɔ yi, na fa hyɛ kukuo bi mu na akyɛre nna bebree. Na sɛ asafo AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, seɛ nie: Wɔbɛtɔ adan ne mfuo ne nturo asase yi so bio.

Na mede ɔtɔ nwoma no maa Neria ba Baruk no, mebɔɔ AWURADE mpaeɛ sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, hwɛ, wo na wode wo tumi kɛseɛ ne wo basa a atene ayɛ ɔsoro ne asase; biribiara nyɛ wo nwanwa; woyɛ nnipa mpem mpem adɔeɛ, na wotua agyanom amumuyɛ so ka gu wɔn mma a wɔdi wɔn akyire kokom, wo Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ ne otumfoɔ a asafo AWURADE ne ne din no. Wo a woso, agyinatuo mu na w’adeyɛ dɔɔso. Wo a w’ani bue hwɛ nnipa mma akwan nyinaa, sɛ wobɛma obiara sɛdeɛ n’akwan ne ne nneyɛɛ aba teɛ no. Wo a woyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ Misraim asase so de bɛsii nnɛ da yi, ne Israel ne nnipa nyinaa mu, na wode gyee din, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. Na wode nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne nsa a ɛyɛ den ne basa a atene ne ahudeɛ kɛseɛ yii wo man Israel firii Misraim asase so, na womaa wɔn asase yi a wokaa ho ntam kyerɛɛ wɔn agyanom sɛ wode bɛma wɔn, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ. Na wɔba bɛdii soɔ no, wɔantie wo, na wɔanni wo mmara so; deɛ wohyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyɛ no nyinaa, wɔanyɛ, enti na woama bɔne yi nyinaa abɛto wɔn yi. Hwɛ, epie no reduru kuro no ho sɛ wɔrebɛgyeɛ, na wɔde kuro no bɛhyɛ Kaldeafoɔ a wɔne no reko no nsa, afena ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ ano, na nsɛm a wokaeɛ no aba mu, na hwɛ, wohunu. Na wo, AWURADE Nyankopɔn ara, woka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Fa dwetɛ tɔ afuo no, na hyɛ ho adansefoɔ. Nso kuro no na wɔde rehyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa yi.

Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa Yeremia nkyɛn sɛ: Hwɛ, me AWURADE ne ɔhonam nyinaa Nyankopɔn; biribi bɛyɛ me den anaa? Enti sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mede kuro yi merehyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa ne Babelhene Nebukadnessar nsa sɛ ɔmfa, na Kaldeafoɔ a wɔne kuro yi reko no bɛba abɛto kuro yi mu gya, na wɔahye ɛno ne adan a wɔahye atifi aduhwam ama Baal na wɔahwie ahwiesa ama anyame foforɔ, sɛ wɔde rehuru me boɔ no. Na Israelfoɔ ne Yudafoɔ de m’anim bɔne yɛ ara nko firi wɔn mmeranteberɛ mu. Na ohuro nko ara na Israelfoɔ de wɔn nsa ano adwuma huru me boɔ, AWURADE asɛm nie. Na abufuo ne abufuhyeɛ nko na kuro yi ahyɛ me, firi da a wɔkyekyereeɛ de abɛduru nnɛ da yi, sɛ menyi no mfiri m’anim, Israelfoɔ ne Yudafoɔ bɔne a wɔyɛɛ no, sɛ wɔde rehuru me boɔ no nyinaa nti, wɔn ne wɔn ahemfo, wɔn mmapɔmma, wɔn asɔfoɔ ne wɔn adiyifoɔ ne Yuda mmarima ne Yerusalemfoɔ. Na wɔdanedanee wɔn atikɔ kyerɛɛ me, na ɛnyɛ wɔn anim; na wɔtuaa nhema kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn, na wɔn deɛ, wɔantie sɛ wɔbɛgye nkyerɛkyerɛ. Na wɔsisii wɔn akyiwadeɛ, efie a wɔde me din atoɔ no mu de guu ho fi. Na wɔsisii Baal sorɔnsorɔmmea a ɛwɔ Hinom ba bonhwa mu no, sɛ wɔrema wɔn mmabanin ne wɔn mmammaa afa ogya mu ama Molek, nso menhyɛɛ wɔn na ɛmmaa m’akoma mu da sɛ wɔnyɛ saa akyiwadeɛ yi mma Yuda nyɛ bɔne.
Na afei saa nti, sei na AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn ka no kuro yi a mose afena ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ nti, ɔde ahyɛ Babel hene nsa no ho. Hwɛ, me ara mɛboa wɔn ano afiri nsase a m’abufuo ne m’abufuhyeɛ ne anibereɛ kɛseɛ mu mesunsumm wɔn kɔɔ hɔ no nyinaa so, na mede wɔn asane aba ha bio, na mama wɔatena ase dwoodwoo, na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn. Na mɛma wɔn akoma korɔ ne ɔkwan korɔ, na wɔasuro me daa nyinaa, na asi wɔn ne wɔn mma a wɔbɛdi wɔn akyire no yie. Na me ne wɔn bɛpam daa apam, na merensane mfiri wɔn akyiri sɛ merenyɛ wɔn yie bio, na mede me suro bɛhyɛ wɔn akoma mu, na wɔamfiri me nkyɛn. Na me ho bɛsane me wɔn ho sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn yie, na mede wɔn madua asase yi so nokorɛ mu, m’akoma nyinaa mu ne me kra nyinaa mu.
Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Sɛdeɛ me bɔne kɛseɛ yi nyinaa aba ɔman yi soɔ no, saa ara na mɛma yie a maka no wɔn ho no nyinaa bɛba wɔn soɔ. Na wɔbɛtɔ mfuo, asase yi a moka sɛ ayɛ amamfo a onipa ne aboa nni so bio a wɔde ahyɛ Kaldeafoɔ nsa no so; wɔde sika bɛtotɔ mfuo, na wɔatwerɛ agu nwoma mu asosɔ ano ahyehyɛ ho adansefoɔ, Benyamin asase so ne Yerusalem ho, ne Yuda nkuro mu ne mmepɔ so nkuro mu, ne mmepɔ ase nkuro mu ne Negeb nkuro mu, na mede wɔn nnommum bɛsane aba, AWURADE asɛm nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!

app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
